subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: After symlink glob parity is repaired, should ordered `agent:bootstrap` handlers intentionally yield to unrelated event-loop work while mutating one shared bootstrap context?
rationale: Source and tests can establish handler order and final values, but only repository owners can define whether bootstrap hook execution is an atomic lifecycle boundary or may be interleaved.

options.title: Accept bootstrap interleaving
options.body: Keep the internal yield, add focused invariant coverage and a lifecycle comment, and require connected runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep handlers atomic
options.body: Remove inter-handler yielding and land the asynchronous workspace reads and cooperative glob traversal independently.

options.title: Redesign context mutation
options.body: Pause until handlers produce explicit patches or snapshots so event-loop interleaving cannot expose partially mutated shared context.

recommendation.title: Accept bootstrap interleaving
recommendation.body: Keep the internal yield, add focused invariant coverage and a lifecycle comment, and require connected runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail spans bootstrap hook introduction, workspace safety, and hook-contract preservation.
